out_items.name: Hands clean and properly washed

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE HANDLING RAW PORK AND CHICKEN WITH GLOVED HANDS AND CHANGING GLOVES WITHOUT WASHING HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REMOVE GLOVES AND WASH HANDS BEFORE DONNING CLEAN GLOVES.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: NOODLES AT 48F IN EVEREST 2 DOOR UPRIGHT REFRIGERATOR; RAW TUNA AT 46F, RAW SALMON AT 46 F IN SUSHI DISPLAY.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC DISCARDED NOODLES DURING INSPECTION; RAW TUNA AND SALMON WERE TRANSFERRED TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F OR BELOW.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: KIMCHI PREPARED FOR 3 DAY PRIOR WITHOUT DATE MARKING IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO APPLY APPROPRIATE DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: When to Wash
violations.observation: A food employee failed to wash his or her hands before engaging in food preparation, after touching bare human body parts, after coughing, sneezing, eating, after handling soiled utensils, or after engaging in any activity that could contaminate the hands. OBSERVED EMPLOYEES NOT WASHING HANDS BETWEEN TASKS AND AFTER CHANGING GLOVES.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands OFTEN especially after handling trash, using the restroom, handling raw meats, handling soiled equipment and utensils, BEFORE putting on clean gloves, etc. Proper handwashing frequencies will aid in the reduction of foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO ENSURE EMPLOYEES TRAINING AND COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: No bare hand contact with ready-to-eat food, or a pre-approved alternative procedure properly allowed

violations.title: No Bare Hand Contact with RTE Foods
violations.observation: Food employee(s) was observed handling the following ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands: OBSERVED EMPLOYEE APPLY GARNISH TO BEVERAGES WITH BARE HANDS.
violations.corrective_action: Except when washing fruits and vegetables, food employees may not contact ready-to-eat foods using their bare hands. Employees shall be using suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, tongs, or clean disposable gloves to handle all ready-to-eat foods. Proper handling of food and effective handwashing procedures will help prevent foodborne illness. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO DISCARD BEVERAGE; WASH HANDS AND APPLY GLOVES BEFORE HANDLING READY TO EAT FOODS. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE ITEMS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE DRAINAGE LINE FROM HANDWASH SINK. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE HANDWASHING SINKS ARE USED ONLY FOR HANDWASHING.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees: AT WOMEN’S BATHROOMS USED BY EMPLOYEES
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: GREEN ONIONS STORED AND CUT ON COUNTER WITH MEAT SLICER AND AREA HEAVILY SOILED WITH RAW MEAT.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO SEPARATE FOOD PREPARATION AREAS AND ENSURE PROPER CLEANING AND SANITIZING OF EQUIPMENT AND COUNTERS AFTER USE TO PREVENT CROSS CONTAMINATION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

PLEASE ENSURE FOODS ARE COOLED FROM 135F TO 70F IN 2 HOURS USING SHALLOW UNCOVERED PANS IN REFRIGERATOR OR FREEZER.

out_items.name: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures and records

violations.title: TPHC, Food Marked with 4 Hour End Point
violations.observation: The following food item(s) for which time rather than temperature is used as a control is not marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control: VARIOUS FOODS IN KITCHEN, SUSHI STATION AND GAVI CAFE WITHOUT 4 HOUR TIME LABELS - COOKED CHICKEN, COOKED PORK, SUSHI RICE, ONIGIRI, VARIOUS PASTRIES,
violations.corrective_action: If time only, rather than time in accordance with temperature control, up to a maximum of 4 hours, is used as the public health control the food shall: 1) have an initial temperature of 41F or less if removed from cold holding temperature OR 135F or above if removed from hot holding temperature control, 2) be marked or otherwise identified to indicate the time that is 4 hours past the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, 3) be cooked and served, served if ready-to- eat, or discarded within 4 hours from the point in time when the food is removed from temperature control, and 4) be discarded if unmarked or marked to exceed a 4 hour limit. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC LABELED FOODS IN SUSHI STATION . PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE FOR ALL STATIONS BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items: IN SUSHI STATION, GAVI CAFE AND KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DESIGNATE SEPARATE STORAGE AREAS FOR CHEMICALS AWAY FROM FOODS, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS AND SINGLE SERVICE ITEMS. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

violations.title: Common Name, Working Containers
violations.observation: Working containers of poisonous and toxic materials are not properly labeled with a common name. VARIOUS SPRAY BOTTLES OF CLEANING CHEMICALS WITHOUT LABELS.
violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO ENSURE LABELS ARE APPLIED DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED COOKED CHICKEN AT 78F FOR 2.5 HOURS IN EVEREST 3 DOOR PREP TOP IN COVERED CONTAINER.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO USE SMALLER PORTIONS, SHALLOW PANS IN THE REFRIGERATOR OR FREEZER TO RAPIDLY COOL FOODS TO THE PROPER COOLING PARAMETERS. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION. Tilly Kitchen (Inspection Date: 12/22/2025) Page 3 of 6

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: OBSERVED COOKED CHICKEN AT 78F FOR 2.5 HOURS IN EVEREST 3 DOOR PREP TOP IN COVERED CONTAINER.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO USE SMALLER PORTIONS, SHALLOW PANS IN THE REFRIGERATOR OR FREEZER TO RAPIDLY COOL FOODS TO THE PROPER COOLING PARAMETERS. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: FROZEN BEEF AND CHICKEN THAWING ON COUNTER IN BACK FOOD PREP AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO TRANSFER FOODS TO REFRIGERATOR TO COMPLETE THAWING DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE.

out_items.name: Food properly labeled, original container

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: WORKING CONTAINERS AND SQUEEZE BOTTLES OF SAUCES, OILS, SPICES, SALT, ETC.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor: IN KITCHEN AND OUTSIDE STORAGE AREA.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PROVIDE APPROVED SHELVING OR DUNNAGE RACKS TOE ELEVATE ALL FOODS AT LEAST 6 INCHES OFF THE FLOOR. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Food Storage No Contamination
violations.observation: Food stored in a location where it is subject to splash, dust or other contamination as follows: FOODS STORED ON SHELVING UNIT UNPROTECTED OUTSIDE THE KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food where it is not exposed to splash, dust or other contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REMOVE ALL FOODS FROM OUTSIDE. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Personal cleanliness

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints: IN MAIN KITCHEN, SUSHI STATION AND GAVI STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO PROVIDE HAIR COVERS FOR ALL EMPLOYEES INVOLVED IN FOOD PREPARATION. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands while preparing food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE EMPLOYEES ARE TRAINED AND COMPLY. COMPLIANCE WILL BE CONFIRMED BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter IN GAVI STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC ASSISTED EMPLOYEE IN PREPARING SANITIZER BUCKET WITH SANITIZER OF APPROPRIATE CONCENTRATION DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: UTENSILS STORED IN WATER AT 68F IN GAVI STATION.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EMPLOYEE REMOVED UTENSILS FOR CLEANING AND SANITIZING DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Non-food contact surfaces clean

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Proper Cooling
violations.observation: The following methods used for cooling were not adequate to facilitate proper cooling: PORTIONED BULGOGI AT 61F (4 HOURS) WRAPPED BAGS AND COOKED CHICKEN AT 62F (4 HOURS) IN COVERED CONTAINER IN EVEREST 3 DOOR PREP TOP (LEFT); MISO BROTH AT 102F (1 HOUR) IN COVERED POT, RICE AT 48-54F (>8 HOURS), BLACK BEANS NOODLE SAUCE AT 48F (>8 HOURS) BOTH IN COVERED CONTAINERS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR;
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. EHS WILL FORWARD ADDITIONAL GUIDANCE DOCUMENTATION IN SPANISH TO ASSIST IN TRAINING EMPLOYEES. Tilly Kitchen (Inspection Date: 06/27/2025) Page 3 of 5

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

out_items.name: Utensils, equipment and linens properly stored, dried and handled

violations.title: Equip/Utensils/Linens, Prohibited Storage Areas
violations.observation: Equipment/utensils were found stored ON SHELVING UNIT OUTSIDE KITCHEN BACK DOOR EXPOSED TO ELEMENTS.
violations.corrective_action: Cleaned and sanitized equipment, utensils, laundered linens, and single-service items may not be stored in: 1) locker rooms, 2) toilet rooms, 3) garbage rooms, 4) mechanical rooms, 5) under sewer lines that are not shielded to intercept potential drips, 6) under leaking water lines including leaking automatic fire sprinkler heads or under lines on which water has condensed, 7) under open stairwells, or 8) under other sources of contamination. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE UTENSILS AND EQUIPMENT ARE CLEANED/RINSED/SANITIZED AND STORED IN PROTECTED AREA AWAY FROM EXTERNAL SOURCES OF CONTAMINATION BY FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Proper date marking and disposition

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: VARIOUS FOODS INCLUDING CHICKEN SOUP, COOKED CHICKEN IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR WITHOUT DATE MARKING.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED STAFF TO APPLY LABEL S DURING INSPECTION

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: OBSERVED IN USE UTENSILS STORED IN WATER AT 70F AT RICE WARMERS AND VARIOUS STATIONS THROUGHOUT KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED AND REPLACED UTENSILS TO STATIONS WITHOUT WATER. PLEASE ENSURE CONTINUED COMPLIANCE .

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Upon discussion with the person-in-charge, one or more of the elements of an effective employee health policy is either missing or incomplete. A complete employee health policy is required to be in place at the food establishment. At the time of this inspection, the Health Department provided and reviewed handouts and resource information in a red folder labeled 'Employee Health Policy.' OBSERVED NO EMPLOYEE HEALTH POLICY ON SITE AT TIME FOF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. Handouts are available in the following languages: English, Arabic, Chinese (traditional), Farsi, Hindi, Korean, Spanish, Thai, Urdu and Vietnamese. If you have any questions about your employee health policy, please contact your area inspector or contact the Health Department at 703-246-2201, TTY 703-591-6435. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND HAVE EACH SIGN. MAINTAIN SIGNED COPIES ON SITE FOR REVIEW DURING YOUR HEALTH DEPARTMENT INSPECTIONS.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS PROVIDED COPY TO PIC. PLEASE REVIEW WITH EMPLOYEES AND HAVE POSTED IN STAFF AREA FOR USE WHEN NECESSARY.

out_items.name: Required records available: shellstock tags, parasite destruction

violations.title: Shellstock, Retaining Labels/Tags for 90 Days
violations.observation: The tags for the molluscan shellfish are not being retained for 90 days. OBSERVED ONE TAG FOR SHELLFISH IN USE AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: The identity of the source of shellstock (oysters, clams, mussels) that are sold or served shall be maintained by retaining shellstock tags or labels for 90 calendar days from the date when the last shellstock from the container is sold or served using one of the following methods: 1) an approved record keeping system that keeps the tags or labels in chronological order correlated to the date when the last shellstock from a container are sold or served, 2) preserving source identification by using a record keeping system, and 3) ensuring that shellstock from one tagged or labeled container are not commingled with shellstock from another container with different certification numbers, different harvest dates, or different growing areas as identified on the tag or label before being ordered by the consumer. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE TAGS ARE MAINTAINED WITH SHELLSTOCK UNTIL SOLD AND DATED WHEN LAST IS SOLD. KEEP TAGS FOR 90 DAYS AND HAVE AVAILABLE FOR REVIEW BY HEALTH DEPARTMENT. Tilly Kitchen (Inspection Date: 11/06/2024) Page 3 of 4

violations.title: Records, Parasite Destruction by Freezing
violations.observation: No records of freezing for parasite destruction are maintained for the following raw, raw marinated, partially cooked or marinated-partially cooked fish that are served or sold in ready-to-eat form: SALMON, SMOKED SALMON, ROE: SMELT, FLYING FISH AND SALMON
violations.corrective_action: If raw or partially cooked fish are served or sold in ready-to-eat form, the person in charge shall record the freezing temperature and time to which the fish are subjected and shall retain the records for the frozen fish at the food establishment for 90 calendar days beyond the time of service or sale to a consumer. If the fish are frozen by a supplier, a letter the fish supplier stipulating that the fish is frozen as required shall be provided. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO REQUEST PARASITE DESTRUCTION LETTER FROM SUPPLIER AND FORWARD VIA EMAIL TO EHS WITHIN 10 DAYS.
